before.name: Oriana Korol
before.description: Oriana Korol was arrested while playing clarinet with a marching band near Portland’s ICE office on October 12, 2025 after becoming caught in another person’s arrest. Prosecutors alleged that she kicked and bit an officer. She spent three days in jail, later pleaded guilty to a reduced misdemeanor assault charge, and was sentenced to time served and supervised release.
